assumptions_analysis.linearity: Moderately linear correlation between temperature, humidity, and fruit variety respiration.
assumptions_analysis.normality_of_residuals: Residuals centered at 0.0251°C with standard deviation 0.9029°C.
assumptions_analysis.homoscedasticity: Residuals remain consistently bounded within ±2.5°C across the operational temperature range [21°C, 27°C].
assumptions_analysis.multicollinearity: One-hot encoding uses drop_first=True to eliminate the dummy variable trap.

viva_takeaway: Linear regression models continuous environmental relationships using Ordinary Least Squares. The model explains 48.9% of the variance in cold-storage temperature with an average absolute error of only 0.76°C. Unlike Decision Trees which make orthogonal step splits, Linear Regression fits a smooth hyper-plane.
